clarifying_questions: Почему распродажа на сайте называется «Финальная»? 1 — магазин закрывается или уходит из части направлений, 2 — обычная распродажа остатков, срока нет, 3 — распродажа до определённой даты (напишите дату). По умолчанию: 2, а в роликах слово «финальная» и сроки не используем. Ответ до 10.10, 18:00.

Кого можно снимать в роликах: 1 — только руки, инструменты и голос, 2 — сотрудников с лицом (с их согласия, например как они играют), 3 — и покупателей (с их согласия на камеру)? По умолчанию: 1. Ответ до 10.10, 18:00.

TikTok: 1 — аккаунт магазина уже есть (пришлите название), 2 — аккаунта нет, заводим новый на Muzzone (мы подготовим, вы подтвердите), 3 — пока без TikTok, начинаем с Instagram и YouTube Shorts? По умолчанию: 2. Ответ до 10.10, 18:00.
output.push_back: Гарантировать, что ролик «залетит» в TikTok, не может никто: даже лучшие модели угадывают успех коротких видео почти наугад, мы это проверяли. Поэтому каждую неделю мы делаем 5 разных роликов на реальных вещах вашего магазина: звук инструментов вблизи, вопросы покупателей, как выбрать первый инструмент. Дальше усиливаем то, что люди сами пересылают и сохраняют, а успех считаем не в просмотрах, а в обращениях в WhatsApp по коду из ролика. Новый аккаунт в TikTok первые 2–3 недели набирает охват неровно, поэтому честную цель зафиксируем в конце второй недели по реальным цифрам; отдельно советуем проверить пункт о возврате, где компенсацию доставки обещают за отзыв: в роликах мы его не используем.

insights.insight: [tension] When someone in Astana decides on a first instrument (for themselves or a child), they want one that is genuinely playable and not wasted money. But they cannot judge quality by eye and fear both «дешёвая — значит не играет» and «дорогую купим, а бросит», so they binge «для начинающих» reviews (this channel's beginner titles got about 6× median, best 64 000) and still put off buying. We can show staff hands playing in-stock entry instruments at 30 cm (Alston AS-100BK 59 800 ₸ ×11, ukuleles from 22 100 ₸), with the real sound and what comes in the box. This moves coded WhatsApp chats from beginners because the next step, «what fits my case», is a natural question to send. Note: the title formula itself did not transfer to Shorts (E40), so the anxiety must be dramatised (sound, hands, the moment of doubt), not just labelled «для начинающих». Lesson-style content was rejected as a vehicle (E37: lessons 129–3 200 views).
insights.tension: Want a first instrument that actually plays well and gets used vs fear of choosing wrong, overpaying, or buying junk that kills the motivation.
insights.who_feels_it: An adult beginner or a parent choosing a child's first guitar, ukulele or piano in the coming weeks, unsure what level of instrument is enough.
insights.content_reality: Hands playing the same simple original riff or chord on AS-100BK through an amp, and strumming U-246, with the phone ≤30 cm from the instrument. Locations are provisional until the reality scan: «зал» (guitar wall) and «прилавок». No faces needed. The fear itself is unverified (no chats), so claims are limited to ledger facts; the rest is recognition content.

insights.insight: [friction] When a beginner browses muzzone.kz for an entry acoustic guitar or ukulele, most listed models say «нет в наличии» (sample: 3/25 acoustics, 4/20 ukuleles in stock; all entry-priced acoustics out). They can't tell what is really on the wall, so they leave or have to ask «а есть?». We can show what is physically in the store this week (re-fetched the same day) and invite the code to check a specific one. This moves coded chats because it turns a dead-end page into a question with an answer. Non-content flag for the owner: an assortment gap in entry acoustic and classical guitars, the classic first instrument, which content cannot fix.
insights.tension: Want to buy a specific affordable model now vs the site mostly shows 'out of stock', creating doubt about whether anything is really available.
insights.who_feels_it: Someone who found Muzzone online, is comparing entry models, and keeps hitting out-of-stock pages.
insights.content_reality: Slow hand-held pan across the real in-stock entry instruments on the wall at «зал», each one strummed or plucked once at 30 cm. Stock is usable ≤48 h, so the same-day re-fetch is mandatory and no «осталось N» is allowed. The customer question is an assumption, so frame it as recognition («Нам часто пишут» only after ≥2 real chats match).

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] When someone buys a first electric guitar (often a parent gifting it), they budget for the guitar only and don't realise it is almost silent without an amp and cable, so they come back confused or buy the wrong add-on. We can show the same AS-100BK unplugged and then plugged into the Hibilly Retro 30R from the sale (56 576 ₸, was 70 720 ₸). Together that is 59 800 + 56 576 = 116 376 ₸ (a derived sum that needs a ledger entry), which crosses the 100 000 ₸ free-delivery threshold. This moves coded chats for a complete beginner set and serves the SECONDARY sale objective without fake urgency. The store's own «дешёвая гитара и дорогой усилитель или наоборот» test (2 600 views) shows the question exists but was framed as a gear debate, not a buyer's mistake.
insights.tension: Want a ready-to-play electric guitar gift vs not knowing it needs an amp (and how much), with fear of a silent, disappointing first day.
insights.who_feels_it: A parent or teen buying a first electric guitar, especially as a gift, who has never owned an amp.
insights.content_reality: Contrast shot at «прилавок»: a strum on the unplugged AS-100BK (thin, quiet), the cable click, then the same strum through the Retro 30R with the phone 30 cm from the speaker. NEEDS FACT: cable included or price; Hibilly stock re-check (2 pcs); derived total added to the ledger.

insights.insight: [price_value] When choosing a ukulele (a typical gift or child's first instrument), buyers see three concert ukuleles in stock at 22 100, 32 901 and 64 501 ₸ that look alike online, all with a case, and cannot hear whether the pricier one is worth it, so they default to the cheapest or stall. We can let them hear it: the same strum at the same distance in blind order, viewers guess, then the true reveal with the spec that differs (solid spruce top on US-C40, maple body on UF-330). This builds the belief that the shop helps you pick honestly, and moves coded chats («какую взять для …?»). Head-to-head titles drew 21 000–28 000 on long-form, but that pattern did not replicate on Shorts (E40), so this is a test, not a bet.

insights.who_feels_it: Someone buying a ukulele for a child, partner or themselves with a 20–65k ₸ budget, comparing models on a phone.
insights.content_reality: Three ukuleles on a stand at «прилавок»; hands strum one identical chord on each at ≤30 cm with the order hidden by numbered cards. Prices are re-fetched within 7 days. No 'laminate' or 'better' claims; the sound is the proof, and any verdict is framed as the viewer's or «мастер считает».

insights.insight: [proof] When a first-time buyer is about to pay 60k–700k ₸ for an instrument, they fear being stuck with the wrong one. The real policy is narrower than people assume: a 14-day return only for UNUSED goods with packaging and receipt, delivery costs withheld; a 12-month minimum warranty; Casio warranty 2 years but service only in Almaty. So the safe move is to hear and try the exact instrument BEFORE paying (in the store on Кажымукана, or by asking in WhatsApp). Saying this plainly is an honest signal that builds trust where peers stay vague, and it ends naturally in a coded chat. The review-for-delivery-compensation clause is deliberately excluded (E14).
insights.tension: Want a safety net if it turns out wrong vs the return policy only covers unused items, so 'try it and return' doesn't really exist.
insights.who_feels_it: A cautious buyer, often a parent or an out-of-Astana customer ordering for delivery, spending a large sum on an unfamiliar category.
insights.content_reality: Screen recording of the site's «Гарантии и возврат» page (screen mode, zero staff minutes), plus hands checking an instrument before handover at «прилавок» (pre-handover tuning or a check is an assumed ritual, so NEEDS FACT from staff). No outcome promises.

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] When someone in an Astana apartment wants to start playing, they want to practise daily but fear neighbours and sleeping family, so they postpone or buy a 'quiet' option blindly. On this channel, the one 'for home' amp comparison got about 10× median and e-drums out-drew acoustic kits. We can show the contrast: a real piano phrase on an in-stock digital piano (Estrada EDP-220BK ×9, AP-270 ×5), then headphones plugged in and the room goes silent. This moves coded chats from pianists and parents of music students, the best-stocked beginner line. Until headphone outputs are in the ledger, it stays recognition content with no feature claim.
insights.tension: Want to play every evening at home vs fear of disturbing neighbours or family.
insights.who_feels_it: Apartment dwellers: a parent of a child at music school, or an adult restarting piano, who plays in the evenings.
insights.content_reality: At «зал» (piano row): phone on the music rest ≤30 cm from the keys catching the sound, then a hand plugs in headphones and the frame goes silent while the fingers keep playing. NEEDS FACT: headphone jacks on EDP-220BK and AP-270 (agent re-fetch of the spec pages or staff confirmation).

insights.insight: [content_reality] Outsiders never hear what a china cymbal, a splash or a cajon sounds like 30 cm away. On the channel's own short clips, odd and extreme sounds were the only outliers (china cymbal 13 000, cajon 6 900, splash 5 600) while model-name cymbal demos sat at a median of 390. The store's sale stock is full of exactly these objects (cymbals, Mapex kits). Wordless close-sound loops where the sound is the hook, not the brand, are the cheapest attention shots and give wildcard ideas an insight to cite; they touch the secondary sale line only lightly.
insights.tension: Curiosity gap: «снаружи этого никто не слышит» vs brand-name demos that nobody but drummers watch.
insights.who_feels_it: Scrollers with no purchase intent, and drummers or percussion-curious people in Astana who share sounds.
insights.content_reality: At «зал» (drum corner), phone 20–30 cm from a sale cymbal or a cajon; a single strike or groove, continuous and loopable, with no music over it. Original playing only (no copyrighted songs). Stock and price are re-checked if the item is named.

insights.insight: [proof] Wildcard: musicians in Astana would forward «это было у нас, в Музzone», because the store has hosted world-class players (Guthrie Govan, Anton Davidyants, Alex Hutchings, Gregg Bissonette), and those clips are among the channel's biggest (39 000–61 000). Vertical re-cuts of the strongest 10–20 s from the store's own footage are zero-staff-minute social-currency content that signals 'this is a real musicians' shop', which beginners and parents also read as legitimacy. It is high variance because its audience is experienced players rather than the beginner target line.
insights.tension: Want to buy from a shop that real musicians respect vs the store looks like any online catalogue from the outside.
insights.who_feels_it: Local guitarists and bassists who share gear moments, and beginners checking whether the shop is 'legit'.
insights.content_reality: Zero staff minutes: re-cuts from file:clients/muzzone/research/youtube_channel.json videos pos355, pos356 and pos371 (source footage to be supplied by the owner). Risk: performance and promo rights of guest artists need owner confirmation before any re-use.

insights.insight: [moment] Before Новый год, parents and partners look for an instrument gift for a child or teen. But the site's children's section lists only 3 synthesizers, and winter ground delivery across Kazakhstan adds worry about a cold instrument arriving. So gift buyers pick blindly or default to a toy. We can show a ready gift by budget from in-stock lines (a ukulele with a case, an electric starter pair, a digital piano), pickup reserve (3 working days) and free delivery over 100 000 ₸. This moves coded chats in the next sprint; pre-shoot from late November. It is mostly assumption, so it is capped low.
insights.tension: Want a meaningful, ready-to-play gift on time vs not knowing what fits the child, and worry about winter delivery.
insights.who_feels_it: A parent, grandparent or partner choosing a New Year gift for a child or teen who 'wants to play'.
insights.content_reality: Hands placing a ukulele into its included case at «прилавок»; pre-shot in the regular session. Care advice («дайте согреться») is only as «мастер советует» after staff confirm it. No dates or urgency without owner confirmation.

insights.insight: [myth] Wildcard: when a buyer sees «Страна производства: Китай» on an entry instrument, many assume it must sound bad, so they either overspend or distrust the cheap option. Most in-stock entry models here are listed as made in China, and the channel itself once used «Китаец VS Японец» framing (only 1 100 views). We can test it on camera: a blind-sound guess between an entry model and a pricier one, with a true reveal and the viewer deciding. If viewers can't tell, it relieves the budget buyer; if they can, that's an honest signal. The belief is not evidenced by any customer words, so this is an exploration slot only.
insights.tension: Want to save money vs belief that 'Made in China' means a bad-sounding instrument.
insights.who_feels_it: A budget-conscious first-time buyer reading spec tables on a phone.
insights.content_reality: Blind A/B at «прилавок»: the same chord on two in-stock instruments with the phone at 30 cm, then the reveal card. No superiority claim and no competitor or country disparagement; the verdict belongs to the viewer. Since the belief is unproven, this is recognition and prediction content only.

insights.insight: [tension] When someone decides to buy a first instrument for themselves or their child, they want one that sounds decent and won't be wasted money. But they can't judge sound from specs (HSS, окуме, 128 vs 192 polyphony), and prices inside one category span up to 10×, so they binge «для начинающих» reviews (8/8 of Muzzone's beginner titles ≥11 000 views, best 64 000) and put the purchase off. We can show 2–3 in-stock instruments played side by side in the showroom by ear, at real ledger prices (AS-100BK 59 800 ₸; ukuleles 22 100 / 32 901 / 64 501 ₸; PX-770 vs AP-270). This moves coded WhatsApp chats from new first-instrument buyers because the natural next step is «код → подскажем под ваш бюджет и что есть сейчас». The tension is the asset, not the word «для начинающих», which did not replicate as a Shorts hook (E40).
insights.tension: Want a safe, good-enough first instrument vs can't hear or judge the difference from specs and prices, and fear overpaying or buying junk
insights.who_feels_it: Someone about to buy a first guitar, ukulele or digital piano, for themselves or a child, comparing listings online without knowing what to listen for
insights.content_reality: Hands play the same 5-second phrase on 2–3 in-stock instruments, phone 20–30 cm from the soundhole or keys, at «гитарная стена» and «пианино» (provisional names until the staff reality scan). Prices only from the ledger and ≤7 days old; stock re-fetched ≤48 h before publishing.

insights.insight: [content_reality] When people scroll instrument listings, they want to hear the real thing before paying, but catalogue photos are silent, so they fall back on brand names or other shops' reviews. Outsiders never hear the instruments up close (string attack, piano hammer action, a small amp breaking up), and the store's weak phone records exactly that well when held close. Short guitar sound clips were the own channel's quiet winners (14 000–32 000 views), while brand-only cymbal demos sat at a 390 median, so sound works when it's an instrument people buy rather than a brand catalogue. This feeds reach (stop and loop) and wildcards. It moves the objective only indirectly, through profile visits.
insights.tension: Curiosity gap: «как это звучит вживую?» vs online listings that are silent or recorded from across the room
insights.who_feels_it: Anyone scrolling past instrument content who has never heard a guitar, ukulele or digital piano from 20 cm
insights.content_reality: Macro shots with close sound: strum 20 cm from a ukulele soundhole, phone on the piano's music rest, Hibilly combo at 30 cm, at «гитарная стена» and «пианино» (provisional). Sensory only, with no quality claims.

insights.insight: [friction] When a buyer browses muzzone.kz to pick a first instrument, they want to choose a model and buy it. But many listed beginner models are out of stock (sample: acoustic 3/25, ukulele list 4/19, electric 8/25), prices can move 25% in a day (PX-770 695 913 → 521 935 ₸), and even the guitar from the channel's 64 000-view video is out of stock in that colour. So they bounce, or have to ask «а есть?» and wait. We can show the actual instrument on the shelf this week and offer a WhatsApp video of that exact unit. This moves coded chats because the code request is what the viewer already needs, and it turns the catalogue's weakness into the CTA. It also warns us never to re-cut old demos of models that are now unavailable.
insights.tension: Want to pick and buy online vs can't trust that a listed model and price are actually available now
insights.who_feels_it: An online browser, often outside Astana ordering by delivery, who has clicked several listings and hit «нет в наличии»
insights.content_reality: Hands lift an in-stock instrument off «гитарная стена» and play 3 seconds; the CTA offers a video of that exact unit. Stock words only with a ≤48 h re-fetch. NEEDS FACT before use: can staff send per-unit videos within working hours? Until then, the CTA promises only «подскажем, что есть сейчас».

insights.insight: [price_value] When parents decide a child needs a digital piano at home, they want a real-piano feel without overpaying. But the shop's in-stock pianos run from 200 720 to 2 075 617 ₸, the spec sheets read like code (128 vs 192 polyphony), and the box is missing things they assume are included (no bench on the PX-770 or AP-270), so they default to a cheap keyboard or a famous brand. We can show, with hands on keys, what actually changes between price points (PX-770 521 935 ₸ vs AP-270 734 886 ₸ from the ledger; other models once promoted to the ledger), what is and isn't in the box, and honestly that Casio service is in Almaty. This moves coded chats («какое пианино под наш бюджет») from a high-ticket line with deep stock (PX-770 3 pcs, AP-270 5).
insights.tension: Want a real-piano feel for the child's practice vs can't tell why one 'digital piano' costs 3–10× another, so they fear overpaying or under-buying
insights.who_feels_it: A parent whose child plays or is starting piano and who now needs an instrument at home

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] When someone buys a first electric guitar, they want to play at home that evening. But an electric is near-silent without an amp, and the guitar alone looks like the whole purchase (inferred: no chat data yet), so first-timers buy only half a setup or agonise over amps. The own channel's home-amp comparison reached 24 000 views. We can show the AS-100BK unplugged vs through the Hibilly Retro 30R (sale price 56 576 ₸). The pair totals 116 376 ₸, which crosses the 100 000 ₸ free-delivery threshold, a true and useful number for out-of-Astana buyers. This moves coded chats about electric starter setups and uses part of the secondary sale objective (≤20% of slots). No urgency, and never «финальная».
insights.tension: Want to start playing electric guitar at home vs not knowing the guitar needs an amp, or which amp is enough for a flat
insights.who_feels_it: A first-time electric guitar buyer, or a parent buying one for a teenager
insights.content_reality: At «гитарная стена»: an unplugged strum at 20 cm, then the same strum through the Hibilly at 30 cm. Prices re-fetched ≤7 days; Hibilly stock (2 pcs) re-checked ≤48 h with no scarcity words.

insights.insight: [myth] When someone picks a ukulele as a cheap first instrument, they want the one that sounds good, and they assume the dearer one does (the belief is assumed, since there are no customer verbatims), so they overspend or buy the cheapest blind. The ledger gives an honest puzzle: the mid-priced US-C40 (32 901 ₸) is the only one listing a solid spruce top, while the UF-330 costs 31 600 ₸ more with maple; the U-246 is 22 100 ₸, and all three include a case. We can run a blind listen and then reveal the prices. The reveal is true whatever the viewer prefers. This moves chats because it hands viewers a way to choose by ear and invites «помогите выбрать».

insights.insight: [proof] When someone, especially outside Astana, considers paying 60 000–700 000 ₸ for an instrument they haven't touched, they want a way out if it's wrong, but they fear being stuck with it (inferred), so they hesitate or only buy where they can play it first. The ledger has real safety nets, each with costs: a 14-day return of unused goods with packaging and receipt (delivery both ways withheld), a minimum 12-month warranty, Casio's 2 years with service in Almaty, a 3-day pickup reserve and Kaspi payment. We can tell these as a story with the box, labels and receipt, stating the costs honestly. This moves chats from remote buyers by removing the last objection, as relief rather than hype.

It is capped low because the moment is assumed until chats show it.
insights.tension: Need a home practice instrument now vs not knowing what lessons require, and fear of buying the wrong class of instrument

output.name: Muzzone — «Слушаем вблизи» (first-instrument sprint, 2026-10-12 → 2026-11-15)
output.big_idea: Online, every instrument is silent. First-time buyers can't tell a 22 100 ₸ ukulele from a 64 501 ₸ one, or a 521 935 ₸ piano from a 734 886 ₸ one, by reading specs. So Muzzone lets them hear the real, in-stock instruments up close and side by side, with ledger prices and plain answers about delivery, bench and service. The next step is a coded WhatsApp chat: «подскажем под ваш бюджет и что есть сейчас». Tests: it can run to 20+ episodes (every in-stock beginner pair or trio of guitars, ukuleles, pianos and amps, plus every recurring buyer question). It can be proven on camera, because the phone is held 20–30 cm from the instrument and the sound is the proof. Every episode ends in the measured action, a coded WhatsApp chat.
output.why_this_wins:
This rests on evidence, not a forecast (L001: text judgment barely predicts Shorts, ρ 0.07 for retail).
(1) Top tension I01 (strength 4): first-time buyers can't judge sound from specs and fear wasting money. Evidence: 8/8 of Muzzone's beginner titles got ≥11 000 views, best 64 000 (E38, E39). We dramatise the tension, not the phrase «для начинающих», because that hook did not replicate on Shorts (E40, L003).
(2) Close sound is what this weak phone does well. Own short guitar-sound clips got 14 000–32 000 views (I02: E42, E43). Brand-only cymbal and drum demos sat at a 390 median (L006), so every sound clip in this plan is tied to a buyer's question (which one, what's the difference, what else do I need).
(3) Two conversion helpers. I03 friction: many listed beginner models are out of stock and prices move (E26, E29, E30), so the CTA promises only «что есть сейчас». I07 relief for remote buyers uses ledger policy facts (delivery_free_100k, delivery_astana, payments, warranty_casio).
(4) Message: «Сначала послушайте вблизи, потом выбирайте» is advice, not a claim, so it needs no fact id. Peers sell finished-product demos and «для начинающих» titles. Choosing by ear between in-stock options is not what the category says.
(5) Learning plan: week 1 shoots 7 bodies across 7 drivers and 7 formats (prediction_game/guess, curiosity_gap/ab_compare, social_currency/why_it_costs, practical_value/check_before_buy, honest_signal/who_is_it_for, identity/pov_situation, relief/policy_story). Each body gets 2 hook variants and goes to TikTok, Reels and Shorts, each read against its own baseline. The week-1 mix is about 60% reach/hero (ID01, ID03, ID14), 20% utility (ID06) and 20% conversion (ID19), close to the F3 awareness default of 55/30/15. Per-client results are allocation signals only. Arm knowledge comes from pooling identical slugs across clients.

decision_rules: DR1 Read: every post on every platform at 48 h and 7 days. No arm is judged on TikTok before 10 posts (cold start).

DR2 Breakout: ≥3× the platform median at 48 h, or shares+saves per 1k ≥2× the account median. TikTok uses 3× the pooled retail median until 10 own posts. Shorts use 3× the Shorts baseline; [ASSUMPTION] 3 × 2 300 = 6 900 views until 10 new Shorts exist. Within 7 days: 2 follow-ups (a part 2 or the same insight in a new format, plus a reply to the top comment). Pin it if it is conversion-relevant, put it on WhatsApp Status, and make it boost-eligible. At ≥10× it becomes a series; the owner hears «вирусный» with «это редкий всплеск, не план». ID14 becomes the series «POV: вы не музыкант» only through this rule.
DR3 Hook failure: 3-s hold <0.7× the account median → re-cut with a new first frame and hook text, repost ≥7 days later. Once only.
DR4 Body failure: hold fine, completion <0.7× median → shorten and move the payoff earlier in the next episode. No repost as is.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss: views on plan but cumulative coded chats <5 by 2026-11-08 (30% of the expected 15 by end of week 3) → before more content, check that the code is on screen ≥2 s, in the caption and pinned comment, the bio wa.me link, and the median first reply.
DR6 Sales-handling miss: coded chats on plan but «Оплачен» low → report where chats die and draft reply scripts. Price and offers are the owner's call.

DR7 Attention-only arm: ≥10 posts, ≥10 000 total views, 0 coded chats while other arms convert → cap at 2 posts/week. JUDGMENT: the method's 1/week cap is relaxed to 2 because reach is part of this awareness brief, but the success metric is coded chats.
DR8 Retire: P(arm beats client median) <0.10 after ≥8 posts → drop to the exploration floor; the data stays in the pool. Unlikely to trigger inside this sprint.

DR9 Boost: only DR2 posts with ≥1 coded chat or a conversion role (ID03, ID06, ID19 types). Only within the owner's cap, never with an unconfirmed offer. Never boost a post whose featured SKU has re-fetched stock ≤2 (e.g. the Hibilly). Stop at the stop-loss (5× cap spent with <3 coded chats) or when cost per coded chat rises 3 days in a row.

DR10 Capacity (retail = stock + reply capacity): if a featured SKU's re-fetch shows out of stock, unpin the post and swap its CTA to «подскажем похожее, что есть сейчас». If the median first WhatsApp reply is >60 min in working hours, pause conversion pieces and report the leak; if it is >15 min, flag it in the owner report.

DR11 Honesty kill-switch: a comment credibly disputes a price, spec, stock or policy → pause that series, re-fetch and verify, and tell the owner the same day. Publish-day re-fetch is mandatory (prices moved 25% in a day, E26).

DR12 Pivot: by week 4–6, no arm with P >0.6 and coded chats <5 (25% of 20) by 2026-11-15 → rerun step 3 with fresh chats and voice notes, diagnose the funnel, and send the owner an honest report with options (another line, warm base, offer, boost, pause).
DR13 Claims: a «winner» is declared only with P(best) ≥0.9, n ≥10 per contender and an interval; otherwise «лидирует, рано судить».
DR14 Staff: card completion <80% for 2 weeks → fewer locations (max 2), face-free shots only, shorter takes.
DR15 Owner: rejections >30% of a batch → read the reasons and update constraints. A fact rejection fixes the ledger the same day.
DR16 Never delete flops, except for truth, consent or legal problems.

DR17 (judgment) Secondary sale: ≤1 of 5 weekly base videos features a «Распродажа» item, with no «финальная», no end date and no «осталось N». If Q1 = closure or brand exit, stop the awareness build-up and rewrite the brief as a dated sales_push using the warm base.

refutations.why_fails: Одно и то же арпеджио на педали не исчерпает ни 128, ни 192 голоса, поэтому разницы будет не слышно. Получается, ролик «показывает» полифонию, которую показать нельзя, и молча подталкивает к мысли, что 213 тыс. ₸ разницы — это полифония. Фраза «Остальные отличия — спросите консультанта» выглядит как уход от ответа. А ИИ-озвучка в магазине живого звука противоречит самой идее серии.
refutations.fix: Убрать «shown». Либо построить ролик на реальных отличиях, которые подтвердят продавцы (клавиатура, корпус, динамики), и дать живой голос консультанта, либо снять ID05 со слейта, пока ответа нет. Озвучку делает человек, а не ИИ.

refutations.target: Определение «вирусный» = ≥10× от общей медианы розницы (≈300–1 000 просмотров)
refutations.why_fails: Выходит, мне доложат «вирусный» про ролик с 3–10 тысячами просмотров. Это подмена моего слова, и в разговоре с партнёрами это будет неловко. При этом ожидаемый итог — 20 обращений за месяц. Это честно, но совсем не «вирусно». Отговорку про «редкий всплеск» вы прописали, а прямо мне про масштаб не сказали.
refutations.fix: В отчётах писать только абсолютные цифры («ролик набрал 8 400 просмотров, в 12 раз выше нашего обычного»). Слово «вирусный» использовать только от ~100 тыс. просмотров. В первом же сообщении прямо сказать: цель месяца — 20 обращений, а не миллион просмотров.

refutations.target: Владелец — выгрузка чатов WhatsApp («Имена и номера удаляем сразу») при метрике «новый контакт = номер без истории»
refutations.why_fails: Одно противоречит другому: если номера удалить, нельзя проверить, новый ли это контакт. Сами клиентские переписки уходят внешнему ИИ-подрядчику, а это персональные данные покупателей. Если об этом узнают, будет и юридический риск по закону РК о персональных данных, и удар по репутации.
refutations.fix: Пусть сотрудник сам помечает новые контакты ярлыком «Новый» прямо в WhatsApp, а наружу уходит только обезличенный текст или счётчики. Либо номера хэшировать на нашей стороне. Нужно письменно указать, где хранятся данные и когда их удаляют.

refutations.target: Сроки ответов и время владельца
refutations.why_fails: В intake вопросы стоят «до 10.10 12:00», а это сегодня, при том что связь со мной идёт через Андрея и Павла. В owner_asks тот же вопрос стоит уже «до 14.10». Всего просьб ко мне 10 штук примерно на 18 минут, а договорённость была не больше 15 минут на старт. Одобрение в среду и публикация в среду тоже не выдержат цепочки через посредников.
refutations.fix: Один срок — 14.10. В одном сообщении три вопроса (финальная распродажа, TikTok-аккаунт, кого можно снимать), остальное в неделю 1. Утверждение в понедельник, публикация со среды.

refutations.target: TikTok — аккаунта нет, есть запасной план «Reels + Shorts»
refutations.why_fails: Я просил именно TikTok. Если аккаунт не появится к 14.10, весь «тест на TikTok» превратится в перепосты в Reels и Shorts. При этом первые 10 постов нового аккаунта по вашим же правилам ничего не дают для выводов, то есть почти весь спринт.
refutations.fix: Создание аккаунта поставить первым пунктом, на 2 минуты: прислать мне пошаговую инструкцию. Сказать прямо, что надёжные выводы по TikTok будут только после спринта, и предложить 1–2 поста в день вместо 5 в неделю, раз работы на ролик мало.

refutations.target: ID03 — хиро-ролик на товаре из распродажи (Hibilly, 2 шт., «Было 70 720 ₸»)
refutations.why_fails: Лучшая идея держится на комбике, которого осталось 2 штуки и который относится к «Финальной распродаже» с непонятной причиной. Если его купят в первые дни, ролик-лидер теряет смысл. Если «финальная» значит уход бренда, призыв в ролике начинает вводить в заблуждение.
refutations.fix: Снять второй вариант с комбиком, которого много на складе и который не в распродаже. Публиковать тот, что актуален по остаткам за 48 часов. Старую цену показывать, только если она реально действовала на сайте.

refutations.target: ID06 — проверка №3 «Где сервис: Casio — Алматы»
refutations.why_fails: Честно, но мы сами делаем главным аргументом ролика о покупке то, что ремонт будет в другом городе. Плюс «Банкетки нет ни у одного» не подкреплено фактом в facts_used для AP-270.
refutations.fix: Сервис упомянуть в одной строке вместе с тем, как магазин помогает с гарантийным случаем, но только после подтверждения у сотрудников. Отсутствие банкетки проверить по карточкам обоих товаров. Если в ролике показан PX-770, говорить только про него.

refutations.target: Нагрузка на сотрудников: 7 роликов за 15 минут съёмки, затем неделя 2 с дополнительными задачами
refutations.why_fails: 7 сюжетов по 2–3 дубля с живой игрой за 14,9 минуты рассчитаны впритык и без запаса на покупателей в зале. С недели 2 добавляются «звук по просьбе», «необычное видео» и голосовое, и в 17 минут это реально не влезает.
refutations.fix: Неделя 1 — максимум 5 сюжетов за съёмку. Записывать фактические минуты. Если выходит больше 20 минут, автоматически убирать «необычное видео».

output.persona: veteran_creator: short-form creator and SMM for local retail in Kazakhstan/CIS. I judge whether one staff member with a weak phone can shoot it in 20 minutes, whether people in Astana will stop for it and forward it, and whether it turns into WhatsApp messages rather than just views.
output.best_idea: ID03 (electric guitar unplugged, then through the combo) is the best piece on the slate. The contrast happens on camera, a teen forwards it to a parent («вот что мне надо, не только гитару»), it leads into a real starter set, and it can be shot in one take. ID01 (blind ukulele) is a close second and is the most natural comment-bait. Build the hero series on these two formats only. The stronger idea the slate is missing is the apartment angle that is everywhere in the CIS: «пианино в квартире: соседи vs наушники». Film the acoustic-style sound, then the same passage with headphones plugged in, so all you hear is the clack of the keys. Add the line «играйте в 23:00». It is concrete, everyone in a high-rise relates to it, and it is easy to send to your spouse. That fits Astana far better than polyphony.

refutations.target: ID05: PX-770 vs AP-270 polyphony «shown, not told»
refutations.why_fails: You cannot hear 128 vs 192 polyphony in an arpeggio recorded on a weak phone mic, and TikTok's AAC compression makes it worse. The video promises to show the difference and can't, so the payoff is an AI diagram plus a synthetic voice-over labelled «озвучка ИИ». For a local shop, a robot voice is the quickest way to lose trust, and the comments will say «разницы ноль». It is also a 520–735k ₸ purchase being explained through a spec almost nobody searches for.
refutations.fix: Drop polyphony. Replace it with differences you can see and hear that staff can confirm: a close-up of the key action and touch, the cabinet and look in a living room, and the headphone and quiet-practice scenario. Have a staff member say it in their own voice. If no differences are confirmed, kill ID05 and use the slot for a second «guess» episode.

refutations.target: ID03 / ID01 audio on a weak phone
refutations.why_fails: Cheap Android phones apply automatic gain control and noise suppression. The phone will boost the quiet unplugged strum and squash the amp, so the 'wow, it's quiet' contrast flattens out. The amp will also clip at 30 cm. In ID01, the three ukuleles on the shop wall are almost certainly out of tune with each other, and a detuned chord on the cheap one makes the comparison dishonest in either direction.
refutations.fix: Shoot ID03 as one continuous take: unplugged, then the jack click, then plugged in, with the phone fixed in place 50–70 cm away and the amp on 2–3. Do not shoot separate clips. Turn off noise suppression or use the voice-recorder mode if the phone has one. Add 'tune all three ukuleles with a clip-on tuner' to the shoot card (+2 min) and add that time to the 14.9-minute estimate. That estimate is already unrealistic for 7 bodies across 3 locations with 2–3 takes each, so plan for 20–25 minutes or split the shoot into two sessions.

refutations.target: ID19: delivery policy as a feed post in week 1
refutations.why_fails: Text cards about delivery thresholds and payment methods over a zipper sound are a pure ad. On a cold-start TikTok they will get the floor of 200–300 views and spend 1 of the 5 early posts that set the account's audience signal. It also leaves out what people actually ask: «сколько дней до Караганды?»
refutations.fix: Keep ID19 as a pinned post and Instagram highlight («Как заказать»). Don't count it as a feed test slot in week 1. If you do post it, build it around a real order: «Упаковываем укулеле в Шымкент», with tape, box and label (city only), and answer the delivery-time question honestly with a range staff confirm, or with «уточним в WhatsApp».

refutations.target: ID06: «три проверки» content
refutations.why_fails: Check 1 (88 keys) is something anyone shopping for a piano already knows. Check 3 is 'service is in Almaty', which is honest but sounds like a negative to an Astana buyer when you don't give the next step. All you can save is the bench point. The glissando opening is one of the most overused piano hooks there is.
refutations.fix: Use checks a parent actually gets wrong: weighted (hammer) keys vs light keys (show the key bounce in close-up), whether it has a headphone jack and how many, and whether a bench or 3-pedal unit is included. Keep the warranty line as 'гарантия 2 года, по сервису подскажем в WhatsApp' so it is honest and comes with an action. Open on the key-weight press, not a glissando.

refutations.target: Attribution: typed codes as the only success metric
refutations.why_fails: KZ viewers don't type codes. They write «цена?» in the comments, DM on TikTok or Instagram, or call. TikTok shows one bio link at most, and a business link can be limited on a new account, so per-video wa.me links don't exist there. The plan will report «4 coded chats» while the inbox fills up, and DR5/DR12 will fire for the wrong reason.
refutations.fix: Use short word codes that read naturally, like «УКУЛЕЛЕ», «КОМБИК», «ПИАНИНО». Add a reply rule for comments: answer every «цена» comment with the code and the WhatsApp number. Count TikTok and Instagram DMs and comment-to-chat handoffs as a second tier. Treat total inbound vs week 0 as the main read, not just a footnote.

refutations.target: TikTok account setup / cross-posting
refutations.why_fails: The plan doesn't say how the account gets set up. If it is registered or posted to from a phone on a VPN or a foreign SIM, or by an agency outside KZ, the For You page serves it to the wrong country and the 'cold start' never reaches Astana. Re-uploading TikTok exports with the watermark to Reels or Shorts gets them suppressed.
refutations.fix: The owner or staff creates the account on a KZ SIM, from the shop phone, in Astana, with no VPN. Export clean masters with no watermark and upload natively to each platform. Add one line to the owner ask covering this.

refutations.target: Missing dombra / local first-instrument reality
refutations.why_fails: In Kazakhstan the dombra is one of the most common first instruments for a child, because of school, family and music schools. Leaving it out of 'first instrument for a child' means the plan misses the most local, most shareable content (dombra vs ukulele, how to choose one for a child). Everything on the slate is generic Western beginner retail that any shop in Moscow could post.
refutations.fix: Add one owner question: do you sell dombras or have them in stock? If yes, a «домбра или укулеле для ребёнка?» guess or who-is-it-for episode goes into week 2, with Kazakh-language comments welcome and the RU caption checked by a native speaker.

refutations.target: ID14: POV with no person
refutations.why_fails: A 'POV' clip that is just a phone panning along a guitar wall with thought bubbles is the most generic shop-TikTok format there is. With no face and no voice, nothing about it is recognisably Muzzone (brand link 2). It will be scrolled past as stock footage.
refutations.fix: Add a real voice: the consultant answers off-camera in 1–2 sentences («Классика, нейлон — пальцам легче. Размер скажем по возрасту.»). This needs a staff-confirmed fact. Or have the hand pick up the guitar and the consultant's line be the payoff. Keep it as a wildcard.

refutations.target: Faceless strategy overall
refutations.why_fails: Local shop accounts in the CIS spread through a recognisable seller personality: a recurring voice and their phrases. Hands-only clips with burned-in text read as catalogue content and rarely build followers or trust strong enough to get a DM about a 500k ₸ purchase.
refutations.fix: Push the consent question to the owner harder. Even without faces, use one consistent staff voice reading the hook and the verdict in every hero episode. Start that from week 2 if the week-0 voice test sounds clean.

refutations.target: Endings with price reveals and sums
refutations.why_fails: Ending every video on «Гитара — 59 800 ₸ / Комбик — 56 576 ₸ / Вместе — 116 376 ₸ / доставка…» turns the payoff into a price list. Retention drops at the price card, and the loop is lost.
refutations.fix: Show at most one price line on screen and put the rest in the caption and the WhatsApp reply. End on the sound, the reveal or the verdict, then the code for 2 seconds.

output.name: Muzzone — «Слушаем вблизи» (first-instrument sprint, 2026-10-12 → 2026-11-15), revision 2 after boss + creator review
output.big_idea: Online, every instrument is silent and every spec sheet reads like code. A first-time buyer can't hear the difference between a 22 100 ₸ ukulele and a 64 501 ₸ one, and can't see what a digital piano box is missing. Muzzone lets them hear and see real, in-stock instruments up close, side by side, with fresh ledger prices. The next step is always a chat: «напишите — подскажем под ваш бюджет и что есть сейчас». Tests: (1) It can run to 20+ episodes: every in-stock beginner pair or trio of ukuleles, guitars, amps, pianos and, if stocked, dombras, plus every recurring buyer question. (2) It is provable on camera, because the sound and the close-up are the proof. Claims are limited to what the ledger or the camera verifies; polyphony was dropped because a phone mic cannot show it. (3) Every episode ends in the measured action, a coded or otherwise attributed inquiry.
output.why_this_wins:
This is evidence plus a learning plan, not a forecast (L001: a text judge predicts retail Shorts at ρ 0.07).
(1) Top tension I01 (strength 4): first-time buyers can't judge sound from specs and fear wasting money. 8/8 of Muzzone's beginner titles got ≥11 000 views, the best 64 000 (E38, E39). We dramatise the tension rather than the phrase «для начинающих», which did not replicate on Shorts (E40, L003).
(2) Close sound is what one weak phone can do, if it is handled honestly: own short guitar-sound clips got 14 000–32 000 views (I02: E42, E43), while brand-only cymbal demos sat at a 390 median (L006). So every clip answers a buyer question. After the creator review, the audio protocol now protects the comparison itself: ukuleles tuned with a clip-on tuner, ID03 shot as one continuous fixed-distance take, phone noise suppression off.
(3) Claims shrink to what is provable. ID05 no longer 'shows' polyphony and uses no AI voice. It runs only on staff-confirmed visible or audible differences, in a staff member's own voice, or it is killed. ID06's checks are now things parents actually get wrong (key weight, headphone outputs, bench and pedals). ID19 drops the unverified Astana courier line and the unconfirmed cash-on-delivery line.
(4) Conversion is measured the way KZ buyers actually behave: word codes (proposed to code), a templated reply to «цена?» comments, platform DMs and comment-to-chat handoffs as tier 2, and new-contact inbound vs week 0 as the main decision read.
(5) Learning plan: week 1 publishes 4–5 bodies across 5 drivers and 5 formats (prediction_game/guess, curiosity_gap/ab_compare, identity/pov_situation, practical_value/check_before_buy, honest_signal/who_is_it_for). Each body gets 2 hook variants and is uploaded natively, as a clean master with no watermark, to TikTok, Reels and Shorts. Each platform is read against its own baseline. Per-client reads are allocation signals only; arm knowledge comes from pooling identical slugs across clients.
Known gap: the slate has no dombra, which is the most local first instrument. It is a week-0 site fetch plus one owner question, and a NEXT BATCH idea for week 2.

series.name: «Слушаем вблизи»
series.role: HERO. Reach + consideration. Metrics: views_48h ÷ platform median, avg % watched and comments per 1k, then attributed inquiries per 1k per instrument line. Opening ritual: frame 1 is hands already playing and sound onset at 0 s, a small «№N» top-left, hook upper-middle, price tags hidden until the reveal. Fixed structure: the same phrase on 2–3 in-stock, tuned instruments at the same phone distance → the turn (reveal, plug-in or a confirmed difference) → ledger prices re-fetched on publish day → «подскажем под ваш бюджет». The variable is the instrument set. Stranger test: episode 7 is «две акустики, одна фраза — какая дороже?». ID05 is conditional: it is rebuilt without polyphony, using staff-confirmed differences (key action, cabinet and look, headphone quiet practice) in a staff member's own voice; if nothing is confirmed by 2026-10-23 it is killed and its slot goes to a second «guess» episode (NEXT BATCH).
series.cadence: 2/week. Week 1: ID01 Wed 21.10, ID03 Fri 23.10. ID05 only from week 2 and only if confirmed. Each episode ≤4 staff min, including tuning and set-up.

series.name: «Перед покупкой»
series.role: UTILITY / proof. Metrics: saves per 1k, then attributed inquiries naming an instrument type. Opening: a close physical action with sound (a key pressed and released, not a glissando), then a numbered or either/or promise paid off in ≤25 s. ID06 is rebuilt around checks parents actually get wrong: key weight, number of headphone outputs, bench and pedal unit in the box. The warranty line comes with an action: «Гарантия Casio 2 года, сервис в Алматы» + «Как обратиться в сервис — подскажем». Opinions are labelled «так считает наш консультант».
series.cadence: 1–2/week. Week 1: ID06 Sat 24.10. ID13 Sun 25.10 if its 10-s voice line was recorded in the week-1 session, otherwise week 2.

series.name: «Как заказать в другой город»
series.role: CONVERSION / relief for buyers outside Astana (I07). Not a feed test slot in week 1. It is a pinned post plus an Instagram highlight («Как заказать»). Feed episodes are built only around a real outgoing order: «Упаковываем укулеле в [город]», with tape, box and a label showing the city only, no names or addresses. Delivery time is either a staff-confirmed range or «сроки уточним в WhatsApp». Lines allowed now: free delivery across Kazakhstan above 100 000 ₸ by ground transport (delivery_free_100k), and «Оплата: Kaspi или карта» (payments). The Astana courier rule (delivery_astana) is held until the agent re-reads the site verbatim and quotes it with the page reference. Cash on receipt is held until Andrey/Pavel confirm it for regional delivery. Metrics: attributed inquiries from outside Astana per 1k, and the city split.
series.cadence: Pinned and highlight from week 1, built from week-1 footage with zero staff minutes. Feed episodes from week 2, only when a real out-of-city order is packed (if-then trigger on the card, ~1.6 min).

series.name: «Отвечаем видео»
series.role: REPLY. Comments and follows per 1k, plus attributed inquiries. Opening: the platform's native reply sticker with a real comment, then close footage that answers it. Zero staff minutes when library takes cover the answer. Built only from a real, answerable comment. «Цена?» comments are answered in text by the approved template, not by a video.
series.cadence: From week 2: 1/week when an answerable comment exists, otherwise the slot goes to a reserve body.

offer.proposal: Новых акций нет. Уже действует и можно упоминать как есть: при самовывозе резерв держится 3 рабочих дня, можно попросить продлить (pickup_reserve). Цены «Распродажи» показываем ровно как на сайте, без слова «финальная», без сроков и без «осталось N». Кандидат на неделю 3, только после „да“ владельца и без скидки: «Напишите в WhatsApp {CODE} — до оплаты пришлём видео именно вашего инструмента: как он звучит вблизи». Условия: только для товаров, которые есть в наличии по данным сайта на день ответа; видео присылаем в рабочие часы; это не бронь и не скидка. Проверяем как вариант CTA (с предложением / без) внутри одной серии.

channels.role: The boss's channel and the main test bed for non-follower reach. Set-up rule, in the owner ask: the owner or staff create the account from the shop phone in Astana on a Kazakhstan SIM, with no VPN. Every upload is made from a device physically in Kazakhstan with no VPN, by Andrey/Pavel if they are in KZ or otherwise staff at ~1 min per post, so the For You page seeds Kazakhstan, not another country. Uploads are native: clean masters with no watermark and no re-upload from another platform. Arms are not judged on the first 10 posts. Original instrument sound only. Per-video wa.me links don't exist on TikTok, and [ASSUMPTION] a new business account's bio link may be limited, so the code goes on screen ≥2 s, in the caption and in a pinned comment. The WhatsApp number (wa fact) goes in the bio as text. If the owner never sets up TikTok, the sprint runs on Reels + Shorts and this is reported plainly.

Reach, plus the shop window where KZ buyers check legitimacy. Native upload of the clean master with a Reels cover; never a TikTok export with a watermark. Pin 3: the ID19 «Как заказать» post, ID06, and the best «Слушаем вблизи» episode by 48-h read. Bio: what we sell / «Астана, ул. Кажымукана, 14» (address) / call hours Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00, Sat 10:00–17:00 (hours) / a wa.me link with a bio code. Highlights: «Как заказать», «Доставка и возврат». No «Цены» highlight, because prices move (E26). Instagram DMs and comment handoffs are counted as tier 2.

Native upload of every clean master. The channel has 3 620 subscribers and has been dormant since 2026-05-10. Read against its own Shorts baseline; [ASSUMPTION] the 2 300 channel median includes long-form, so it is replaced after 10 new Shorts. Optional search line (L004): plain model-name titles on YouTube only («Alston AS-100BK без комбика и с комбиком», «Укулеле Caesar U-246, US-C40, Alston UF-330: звук»), never used as a TikTok hook formula (L003).

CONVERSION. Codes: we propose to code that each video's code be a short Russian word for its line plus a digit (e.g. УКУЛЕЛЕ 1, КОМБИК 1, ПИАНИНО 1), so viewers can type it and per-video attribution survives. Code assigns them; copy uses {CODE}. Quick reply (RU, approved once): «Здравствуйте! Вы по видео {CODE}. Подскажите примерный бюджет — сразу скажем, что есть сейчас под него и как забрать или доставить в ваш город.» Codeless chats get «Подскажите, откуда о нас узнали?». Staff labels in WhatsApp Business: «Новый» on every chat with no earlier history on the shop phone, «Видео» when the person mentions a video, code or TikTok/Instagram, and «Оплачен». The handover reply asks for a 2GIS/Google review with no incentive; the review-for-delivery compensation in returns_cost is never mentioned. Target: median first reply ≤15 min in working hours, which are assumed to be the call hours until the owner confirms. A median over 60 min is reported as the top leak before any more content is made. Privacy: by default nothing personal leaves the shop; only label counts and the staff voice note do.

The KZ default is to ask «цена?» in the comments. The agent drafts a reply to every «цена/сколько/есть?» comment within working hours, from a template the owner approves once: «Сейчас [модель] — [цена с сайта на дату] ₸. Напишите в WhatsApp слово {CODE} — подскажем, что есть сейчас. Номер в профиле.» The price comes only from a ledger fact ≤7 days old; if none is fresh, the price line is dropped. decision_rules: DR1 Read: every post on every platform at 48 h and 7 days. No arm is judged on TikTok before 10 posts (cold start).

DR2 Breakout: ≥3× platform median at 48 h, or shares+saves per 1k ≥2× account median. TikTok uses the pooled retail median until 10 own posts; Shorts use [ASSUMPTION] 6 900 views (3 × 2 300) until 10 new Shorts. Within 7 days: 2 follow-ups (a part 2 or the same insight in a new format, plus a reply to the top comment). Pin if conversion-relevant, put on WhatsApp Status, boost-eligible. Owner wording is always absolute: «N просмотров, в X раз выше нашего обычного». «Вирусный» only at ≥100 000 views AND ≥10× median, with «это редкий всплеск, не план». A series is created at ≥10× regardless of the word. ID14 becomes a series («POV: вы не музыкант») only through this rule.
DR3 Hook failure: 3-s hold <0.7× account median → re-cut with a new first frame and hook text, repost ≥7 days later, once only.
DR4 Body failure: hold fine, completion <0.7× median → shorten and move the payoff earlier in the next episode. No repost as is.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss: views on plan but tiers 1+2 <5 by 2026-11-08 AND new-contact inbound not above week 0 → before more content, check the code on screen ≥2 s, in the caption and pinned comment, the bio number or link, «цена?» reply speed, and the median first reply. If tier 2 is healthy but tier 1 ≈0, the codes aren't being typed: change the code wording, not the content.

DR6 Sales-handling miss: inquiries on plan but «Оплачен» low → report where chats die (from staff voice notes, or the export if option 2) and draft reply scripts. Price and offers are the owner's call.
DR7 Attention-only arm: ≥10 posts, ≥10 000 views, 0 tier 1+2 inquiries while other arms convert → cap at 2 posts/week (JUDGMENT: relaxed from 1 because reach is part of this awareness brief).
DR8 Retire: P(arm beats client median) <0.10 after ≥8 posts → exploration floor; data stays in the pool.

DR9 Boost: only DR2 posts with ≥1 attributed inquiry or a conversion role, within the owner's cap, never with an unconfirmed offer, never on a featured SKU with re-fetched stock ≤2. Stop at the stop-loss (5× cap with <3 coded chats) or when cost per coded chat rises 3 days in a row.

DR10 Capacity (stock + reply): a featured SKU out of stock on re-fetch → unpin and swap the CTA to «подскажем похожее, что есть сейчас». Median first reply >60 min in working hours → pause conversion pieces and report the leak; >15 min → flag in the owner report.

DR11 Honesty kill-switch: a comment credibly disputes a price, spec, stock, delivery or policy line → pause that series, re-fetch and verify, tell the owner the same day. Publish-day re-fetch is mandatory (prices moved 25% in a day, E26). Delivery and payment lines publish only as verbatim site quotes or owner-confirmed answers.

DR12 Pivot: by week 4–6, no arm with P >0.6 and tiers 1+2 <5 by 2026-11-15 with new-contact inbound flat vs week 0 → rerun step 3 with fresh voice notes and comments, diagnose the funnel, and send the owner an honest report with options (another line, warm base, offer, boost, pause).
DR13 Claims: «winner» only with P(best) ≥0.9, n ≥10 per contender and an interval; otherwise «лидирует, рано судить».
DR14 Staff: staff report actual shoot minutes. If an actual session exceeds 20 min, or card completion is <80% for 2 weeks → next card has ≤3 bodies, 1–2 locations, face-free only, shorter takes.
DR15 Owner: rejections >30% of a batch → read the reasons and update constraints. A fact rejection fixes the ledger the same day.
DR16 Never delete flops, except for truth, consent or legal problems.

DR17 (judgment) Secondary sale: ≤1 of 5 weekly base videos features a «Распродажа» item; no «финальная», no end date, no «осталось N». If Q1 = closure or brand exit, stop the awareness build-up and rewrite as a dated sales_push using the warm base.

DR18 (judgment) ID05 gate: if by 2026-10-23 staff have confirmed no visible or audible PX-770 vs AP-270 difference, ID05 is killed and the hero slot goes to a second «guess» episode from the next batch. Polyphony is never the payoff and there is no AI voice-over.

DR19 (judgment) Comment replies: every «цена/сколько/есть?» comment gets the owner-approved template within working hours, with a ledger price ≤7 days old or no price at all. Any reply outside the template goes into the weekly approval batch.

Staff time: the code model may not include tuning and amp set-up minutes. They are added manually here (ID01 +2, ID03 +1). Week 1 is cut from 7 to 4–5 bodies to stay ≤17 planned min; actual time is measured and DR14 re-fits the card
Attribution: word codes are a proposal to code (G+); until code adopts them, codes may be less typeable and tier 1 will undercount. Tiers 2 and 3 cover this gap

output.persona: Владелец Muzzone (босс). Просил: «Сделайте нас вирусными в TikTok». Читаю через Андрея/Павла, времени мало, бюджет 0 ₸.
output.best_idea: Серия «Слушаем вблизи» (ID01: три укулеле, один аккорд, «где дорогая?», ID03: электрогитара без комбика и с комбиком). Это дёшево: руки, инструменты и живой звук без лиц, около 3 минут сотрудника на ролик. Видно, что продаём именно мы. Есть понятный следующий шаг: написать в WhatsApp. Если угадаем, из этого выйдет 20+ серий. Ещё хорошо, что мне честно говорят про масштаб: цель — около 20 новых обращений, а «вирусный» означает от 100 000 просмотров.

refutations.target: TikTok-канал: по умолчанию «пока аккаунта нет, публикуем в Reels и YouTube Shorts»
refutations.why_fails: Я просил именно TikTok. Если мой ответ по TikTok задержится, план по умолчанию тихо уходит в Reels и Shorts, а мне потом напишут «так и было оговорено». Аккаунта нет, кто его создаёт, неясно. Андрей и Павел могут быть не в Казахстане. При этом недели 1–2 уже расписаны под публикации.
refutations.fix: В неделе 0 сделать создание TikTok-аккаунта задачей с именем исполнителя и сроком 16.10: сотрудник создаёт его с телефона магазина за 5 минут по инструкции и сам публикует. Если к 16.10 аккаунта нет, напомнить мне один раз отдельным сообщением. Перенос в Reels/Shorts не должен быть молчаливым вариантом по умолчанию.

refutations.target: Карточки слейта (ID05, ID06, ID19) расходятся с исправленной кампанией
refutations.why_fails: В слейте ID05 всё ещё с полифонией, ИИ-озвучкой и фразой «спросите консультанта». ID06 начинается с глиссандо и проверяет старые пункты. В ID19 остались курьер по Астане и оплата наличными, хотя кампания эти строки сама запрещает. Если продавец или монтаж возьмут не ту карточку, в сеть уйдёт неподтверждённое обещание о доставке или оплате. Отвечать за это придётся мне.
refutations.fix: Переписать карточки ID05, ID06 и ID19 в слейте под ревизию 2 или удалить старые версии. На утверждение мне и на съёмку должна идти одна версия на каждый ролик.

refutations.target: Мой лимит времени: ≤15 минут на запуск
refutations.why_fails: Вопросы недели 0 занимают 0,5+1+1+3+2+1+1,5+1+2+3 = 16 минут, а в сумме с вопросами недели 2 выходит 18. Это сверх обещанного. Кроме того, в брифе я должен был ответить до 10.10 12:00, а в кампании стоит 14.10, а сегодня уже 10.10. Какой срок настоящий, непонятно.
refutations.fix: Оставить 4 обязательных вопроса: «Финальная» распродажа, TikTok, тексты ответов, кого снимать. Скриншоты Instagram и уточнения по доставке перенести на неделю 1 или передать агенту и сотруднику. Указать один срок для всех ответов.

refutations.target: Скрытые затраты времени сотрудников: публикация, ответы на «цена?», ярлыки
refutations.why_fails: В бюджет «≤17 минут в неделю» не вошли 15 загрузок в неделю (5 роликов × 3 платформы, по минуте на загрузку). Не вошли и ответы на каждый комментарий «цена?» в рабочие часы: агент их только составляет, а публиковать кто-то должен руками. И ярлык «Новый» нужно ставить на каждый новый чат каждый день. На деле это легко 30–40 минут в неделю, то есть план недооценивает время в 2 раза.
refutations.fix: Посчитать в бюджете загрузку и ответы на комментарии поимённо: кто делает и сколько минут. Если выходит больше 20 минут, грузить только в TikTok и Reels, а Shorts отложить. Или пусть Андрей/Павел грузят удалённо с подтверждённого устройства в Казахстане.

refutations.target: Базовая неделя 0 (12–18.10) по ярлыкам «Новый»
refutations.why_fails: Ярлыки должны стоять с понедельника 12.10. Но мои ответы ждут до 14.10, а инструкцию сотруднику «пришлём». Значит, базовая неделя посчитается за 3–4 дня, и это меньше полной недели. Тогда пересчёт цели 01.11 «во сколько раз больше обычного» получится завышенным, и отчёт будет врать в нашу пользу.
refutations.fix: Отправить инструкцию по ярлыкам сегодня отдельно от моих вопросов. Если неделя 0 неполная, пересчитать её на 7 дней и прямо написать об этом в отчёте. Или взять как базу 4 недели переписки до кампании, посчитанные по ярлыкам задним числом.

refutations.target: ID06 и ID13: «сервис Casio в Алматы» и «не берите дорогое сразу»
refutations.why_fails: Честно, но в продающем ролике мы сами выставляем слабое место: магазин в Астане, а сервис в Алматы. А совет «не берите дорогое сразу» срезает средний чек как раз на пианино за 520–735 тыс. ₸. Наценки моей вы не знаете, но уже ведёте покупателя к дешёвому.
refutations.fix: Строку про сервис оставить, но только вместе с решением: «отправку в сервис берём на себя», если я это подтвержу. Иначе убрать её из хука и с экрана, оставить в ответах в WhatsApp. Совет консультанта сформулировать так: «начните с [модель], если не уверены», без противопоставления дорогому.

refutations.target: ID03: «Вместе — 116 376 ₸» рядом с «Было 70 720 ₸»
refutations.why_fails: Зритель поймёт это как готовый комплект или акцию «гитара + комбик», а такого предложения у нас нет. Плюс комбика в наличии 2 штуки, и на распродажном товаре вопрос «Финальная» ещё не решён. Купят один, и через день ролик станет неправдой.
refutations.fix: Подписать «если брать оба по ценам сайта на [дату]», без слова «комплект». В день публикации проверить наличие. Пока я не ответил про «Финальную», в первую неделю показать гитару не с распродажным комбиком.

refutations.target: Цель «20 обращений» при холодном старте
refutations.why_fails: По вашим же правилам на TikTok нельзя судить, пока нет 10 постов, а в первую неделю их будет 4–5. Получается, к пересмотру цели 01.11 по TikTok будет около 10 постов и разброс в 10 раз. Я рискую потратить месяц и узнать только, что «рано судить».
refutations.fix: Дать мне одну проверку на 01.11 с понятным решением: если на всех платформах вместе меньше 5 обращений и новых чатов не больше, чем в неделю 0, сокращаем до 3 роликов в неделю и смотрим, где теряются клиенты. Если больше, продолжаем.

output.persona: veteran_creator: short-form creator and SMM for local businesses in Kazakhstan and the CIS. I check whether a piece is generic or ad-like, whether one weak phone can shoot it in 20 minutes, and whether it will spread and bring inquiries.
output.best_idea: ID01 «Три укулеле, один аккорд. Где дорогая?» is the best idea. It has sound in frame 1, a stake viewers can act on, an answer by about 15 s, and it can run as a series. Its strongest form is to make the likely result the payoff: when viewers can't hear the difference, the honest line «не слышите разницы — не переплачивайте за первую» builds trust and gets shared. In KZ that does more than any price reveal. Runner-up and cheapest to add: a POV parent episode built as a screen recording of a WhatsApp chat («мам, купи гитару» → «а какую?»). It uses zero staff minutes and is a very native format here.

refutations.target: ID01 blind ukulele: audible difference on a weak phone
refutations.why_fails: A cheap phone mic at 20 cm, auto gain, TikTok's AAC compression and the viewer's phone speaker together all but erase the difference between a 22 100 ₸ and a 64 501 ₸ ukulele. Most comments will say «одинаково» or «наугад». The plan reveals prices as if the difference were real and gives no answer to «you can't hear it». Also, on_screen_ru lists a fixed answer order (2 = UF-330) while what_happens says the order is randomised. If the editor follows the card, the reveal is wrong.
refutations.fix: Add a planned branch for the likely result. Reveal card 2: «Не услышали разницы? Для первой укулеле это нормальный ответ — разница в дереве, ладах и строе, а не в цене на слух» (stating the differences needs a staff-confirmed fact). Have staff play one recognisable pattern, not a single strum, because a 4-s melodic phrase shows tone better than one chord. Generate on_screen_ru answer cards from the final randomised order, never from the card template.

refutations.target: Staff time budget: native uploads not counted
refutations.why_fails: Native uploads from a KZ device with no VPN, 5 bodies with 2 hook variants on 3 platforms, cost about 1 min per post just for TikTok if option Б is chosen. That adds 5 min/week to the week-1 total of 16.6 = 21.6 min, over the 17-min cap and even the 20-min safety line. Hook variants on Reels and Shorts add more. On a real week with a customer at the counter, the shoot drops to 2 bodies.
refutations.fix: Make option А (Andrey/Pavel upload) the hard default and put staff uploads inside the budget. Schedule Instagram and YouTube from Meta Business Suite and YouTube Studio scheduling, which needs no staff. Cut hook variants to TikTok only in week 1. Drop the optional ID13 voice line from the 17-min card unless the measured shoot time comes in under 12 min.

refutations.target: ID06 «Перед покупкой» checks shown as open questions
refutations.why_fails: A checklist save-piece whose answers are «Нажмите клавишу: тяжёлая или лёгкая?», «Сколько выходов на наушники?» with no answer gives nothing to save. Viewers can't press a key through the screen. The PX-770 and AP-270 key action, headphone jacks and built-in 3-pedal unit are public manufacturer specs. Leaving them as «questions» is laziness, not caution, and it makes the piece read as filler.
refutations.fix: In week 0, have the agent pull the Casio official spec pages, and staff confirm with one sentence in the voice note. Publish ID06 only with answered checks («3 педали встроены в корпус», «2 выхода на наушники — можно играть вдвоём тихо»). The headphone line is the real parent hook: quiet practice in an apartment. If the answers aren't confirmed by Fri 16.10, swap Sat 24.10 for ID13 or a reserve.

refutations.target: Whole slate: faceless, voiceless, no local flavour
refutations.why_fails: Hands plus instrument plus burned-in captions is the format every music store in the CIS already posts. It reads as catalogue content. In KZ TikTok, local shop accounts grow on a recognisable person or voice, humour, and Astana or Kazakh-language markers. None of the 5 week-1 videos says «Астана», uses Kazakh, or has a human voice beyond one optional line. The dombra, the most local first instrument and the most likely shared piece, is pushed to «week 2 if stocked».
refutations.fix: Even with no faces, give the series a voice. Have one seller record a 3–5 s voice line per episode in their own words, e.g. «Слушаем вблизи, Астана, Кажымукана 14», plus the payoff line. Do the dombra stock check in week 0 (one site search plus one voice-note question) and slot a dombra-vs-ukulele guess episode in week 1 if stocked. Make Q3 option 2 (seller face with consent) the recommended answer, not just one option.

refutations.target: ID14 POV parent: a hand hovering over a wall
refutations.why_fails: A POV with no person, no voice and only thought-bubble captions over a slow pan is a low-energy stock shot. The opening frame (a wall of guitars) is generic, the hook relies only on text, and the brand link is rated 2. It will sit at about the median.
refutations.fix: Rebuild it in screen mode with zero staff minutes. Show a screen recording of a staged WhatsApp chat labelled «постановка»: child «мам, хочу гитару 🎸», parent «какую??», then three questions (классика/электро? размер? бросит?). Cut to one strum of a real guitar and «Спросите нас — мы подскажем» + {CODE}. This chat format is native in KZ, people share it with the other parent, and it saves shoot time.

refutations.target: ID03 electric unplugged vs amp: the contrast is flattened
refutations.why_fails: The plan correctly names the auto-gain problem, but «noise suppression off» isn't available on most cheap Android cameras. AGC will raise the unplugged strum and pull down the amp, so the «вот так тихо» hook may not land. A bare strummed chord through a small combo also sounds thin on a phone.
refutations.fix: Add a visual proof of loudness that survives AGC. Start with a close-up of the volume knob being turned to 3. Hold the phone still for the whole take and play a simple original power-chord riff, not a cover, to avoid melody rights on a business account. Test one 10-s take in the week-0 scan and decide from it, not in the edit.

refutations.target: Approval chain and owner onboarding time
refutations.why_fails: The week-0 owner asks add up to about 16 min against the 15-min cap. They reach the owner only through Andrey/Pavel. The plan's answer dates (14.10) conflict with the intake (10.10 12:00). Publishing waits for a Wednesday «да» on a Tuesday shoot, so one late reply slips the whole week and kills the cold-start cadence TikTok needs.
refutations.fix: Cut week 0 to the 5 asks that block publishing (Финальная, TikTok, faces, templates, upload person). Move Instagram stats, delivery details and the scale note to week 2. Add a standing rule: if there is no reply by Thursday 12:00, publish only the face-free, price-free cuts (ID14, ID01 without the price reveal), which carry no truth risk. Settle the deadline on one date.

refutations.target: Posting times not specified
refutations.why_fails: The days are set but not the hours. A KZ local audience is on TikTok and Reels mostly 19:00–23:00 Astana time and around lunch. Posting during shop hours right after approval wastes the first-hour signal on a new account.
refutations.fix: Default posting time: 20:00–21:00 Astana time, with Saturday at 12:00 as the alternative. «Цена?» comment replies batched next morning at 10:00 when WhatsApp staffing starts. Log the posting time per post so slot effects can be pooled later.
